text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the training grounds to see how
Mejiro McQueen is faring
on the day after
her tryout race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This won't do. I can't seem to channel
strength into my legs, just like
yesterday.
This is worrisome...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You... I'm sorry, have we met?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, a trainer? Have you come to observe
my routine, perchance?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What an honor! I must thank you for
coming out here for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Though, I must ask: what is it about me
that you wish to observe?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As you no doubt saw, I did naught but
practically drag my family's
name through
the mud at yesterday's tryout race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So after seeing that, why me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Tenacity... I see. Thank you for looking
beyond the surface level.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, it
wouldn't suit me to be weak
of will.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I am glad I was able to
show that I remain
unshakable in my
efforts to succeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Though, I do hope that you will refrain
from deciding whether or not to bring me
under your tutelage until after you have
seen me run
more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Another thing that I possess as a
Mejiro is a certain lofty
ambition—one that I cannot
afford to leave unfulfilled under any 
circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. Namely, victory at the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is, of course, something I cannot
hope to accomplish without the
proper
guidance from a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If that trainer were not able to place
their full confidence in my
ability, then there is
no conceivable way that I would receive
said guidance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So again, please wait to decide whether or
not to scout me until you
have properly
assessed my capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I need to be assured that my trainer will
uphold me to the standards
expected of a
Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It is such a privilege to have
been born to my house.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am surrounded by a caring
family—people who have supported me my
whole life.
I could not abide letting any of
them down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is thanks to them that I even stand on
this training track now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I, as a Mejiro Umamusume,
want nothing more than to
achieve the
glory befitting of my family name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To that end, I must insist that you only
make your decision after you
witness my
physical ability as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I know very well that my showing yesterday was incredibly poor... But I will redeem myself here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Here I go. Observe the fruits of years of
training within the Mejiro
estate!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen takes off running, her
spirits appearing somewhat
renewed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Likely owing to the fact that she has been
training from a young age,
her form is
refined and beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: All right... Once more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She possesses the energy and the tenacity
fit for long distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There is no doubt in my mind that she can
become a first-class stayer,
easily capable
of taking home a win at the spring Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There is one thing I am concerned about,
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... What did you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-well, um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, n-no! That's not the case at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, please excuse me! I'm going to run
one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I can't embarass myself again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen continues to train as if
nothing is amiss. I can clearly
see that isn't
the case, however.
